prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Companion Trait Focus Pick Friend Redesign: Rebuild the pick_friend screen into a spotlight layout with companion trait action cards to help users select pet personalities clearly.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Companion Trait", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select companion behavior trait", "style": "rounded", "role": "pet_choices"}]}}}
1: [home, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Habit Training Screen: Insert an interactive habit schedule screen while pet desktop files render so users can configure daily pet check-ins.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_habit_training", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_habit_training": {"headline": "Set Up Daily Companion Habits", "body": "Select your preferred daily interaction times while your pet initializes.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Choose morning and evening pet check-in times", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Save Schedule", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Pet Personality Customization Flow: Replace standard choice list with a multi-option step-by-step pet personality builder component on pick_friend.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"replace": {"pet_choices": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Step-by-step companion trait selector", "style": "playful", "role": "pet_choices"}]}}}
3: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Workspace Redesign: Redesign home_intro into a two-column workspace preview layout showcasing desktop controls and visibility hotkeys.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion Workspace", "body": "Learn quick hotkeys to talk to, summon, or hide your desktop pet anytime.", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Master basic desktop pet shortcuts", "style": "emphasis", "role": "home_welcome"}]}}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Pet Session Recovery Hint: Add an explicit session recovery hint to sign_in informing users that logging in restores past pets and data.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in automatically locates and restores your previously adopted pets and cloud progress."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Interactive Wait Screen Activity Status: Display interactive initialization stages and time estimates on the waiting screen as pet assets build.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Environment", "body": "Initializing desktop pet animations and shortcut listeners."}}
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Headline: Update the home_intro headline and body to highlight essential keyboard hotkeys for pet visibility.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Press Shift+Pet to Toggle Controls & Visibility", "body": "Your companion lives on your desktop. Use quick hotkeys anytime to hide, move, or speak to your pet."}}
7: [choose_path, incentive] Path Choice Companion Perk Highlight: Add a highlighted badge component on choose_path emphasizing unique companion interaction perks per path.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Includes Unique Companion Desktop Interaction Perks", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [adoption, layout] Compact Adoption Certificate Layout: Switch adoption_certificate to a compact layout with an embedded mascot preview component.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "compact", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "text": "Your desktop companion is ready for adoption!", "style": "rounded"}]}}
9: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Ready System Notification: Enable background notify_when_ready system notification toggle on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Feel free to use other apps! We will ping your system as soon as your pet is ready."}}

verdicts.reason: Replacing pet choices with trait selection loses the required job of choosing a pet.
Adding a new habit training screen within onboarding is allowed and preserves all required steps.
Replacing pet choices with a trait selector fails to perform the job of letting the user choose a pet.
Redesigning the home intro workspace preview is permitted within onboarding and preserves its job.
Adding a session recovery hint to sign in is valid and maintains the screen's function.
Adding progress and time estimates to the waiting screen preserves its function and rules.
Updating text copy on the home intro screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Onboarding copy must not mention perks or free extras.
Compact layout update to adoption certificate maintains its required job and components.
Enabling a notification toggle on the waiting screen is permitted inside onboarding.
